comparison.objective: Candidate extracts one connector terminal; record transfers a coded trapped key to unlock a matching fuse-compartment door while preserving breaker interlock safety.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab release with coupled wire/tool pull versus key extraction, code discrimination, keyway insertion, rotation, and interlocked door operation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective undamaged depinning with missing numeric force/damage limits. Record checks correct-code use, bolt states, prohibited handle/door motion, retained final key, locked-off breaker, and a physical release test.
comparison.reason: Both release a retained item, but the record tests keyed rotational interlocks and safety sequencing, not recessed-tab depinning.
